name: Touhou Little Maid: Orihime
description:
东方小女仆（Touhou Little Maid: Orihime）的非官方 Fabric 移植，目标 Minecraft 26.3。
上游为 NeoForge 版本。与第三方模组的联动只保留在 26.3 上确有对应版本的：JEI、Jade、Sodium、Iris、Patchouli、Cloth Config、Curios、IPN、Extra Container、Farmer's Delight、Kaleidoscope Cookery、PatPat、Traveler's Backpack。
旗指物（hata_sasimono）已拆为独立附属模组 TouhouLittleMaid-HataSasimono。
与原作者及团队无关；不保证与上游存档完全兼容。

An unofficial Fabric port of Touhou Little Maid: Orihime for Minecraft 26.3.
Third-party mod integration is limited to those with a real 26.3 build: JEI, Jade, Sodium, Iris, Patchouli, Cloth Config, Curios, IPN, Extra Container, Farmer's Delight, Kaleidoscope Cookery, PatPat and Traveler's Backpack.
The hata-sasimono item now lives in a separate add-on mod (TouhouLittleMaid-HataSasimono).
Not affiliated with the original authors; save compatibility with upstream builds is not guaranteed.
